reviews.text: My dog ​​has been seeing Dr. Christian for over 5 years. I highly recommend his work; he's attentive, professional, honest, and all the staff at the clinic are helpful and polite. I've recommended him to several friends, and everyone who went has continued to have their dogs treated by him.

Excellent service! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I want to thank Dr. Christian for the care and attention he gave my dog ​​Stella. She needed treatment and today she is much better, thanks to his professionalism.

I highly recommend him! Quality service, dedication and lots of affection for the animals.

Excellent professional with outstanding service.
I recommend him....
Dr. Christian is a special person who, in addition to being an excellent veterinarian, truly loves animals! I also recommend the clinic's grooming services.
The veterinarians are great! Dr. Ariane, in particular, is a sweetheart! They are attentive and truly enjoy what they do, but the reception area leaves much to be desired. Disorganized service.
The service is wonderful, the doctor is great, and the whole team are people who love animals.

Dr. Cris.

Always very attentive and caring with my pets.

I owe the lives of my birds to Dr. Christian. I have two cockatiels, both of whom contracted a fungus and were very ill, especially the male, who was almost dying. He personally treated him every day for two weeks at his own home, monitoring him the entire time and taking him to the clinic. Thanks to him, they have been with me for over 10 years.

I trust them completely! I've always received excellent care from Dr. Christian, Dr. Ariane, and Dr. Gabriel! They are exemplary veterinarians... they took great care of Dimmy and Sol (my cats) and Charlie Brown (my cockatiel). The best! 🤍🤍🤍 …

They don't know how to treat wild animals (birds). I took my bird, which had a problem with its leg, to Dr. Christian. He gave it an injection without even weighing it to measure the dosage, and it died an hour later. When I questioned them, they couldn't tell me why.
